# Reduced deployment regressions

These committed examples are intentionally small reproductions, not complete
production repositories. Pocket's original fixed-port/loopback failure is
reproduced in `pocket-fixed-port` from namankumarsahu/finance-tracker's server
layout. `django-react-sqlite` reproduces EIS-marks-platform's Vite/Django/SQLite
initialization and static-file requirements without any student data. The
business, Express, Next.js, Flask/frontend and owned-Dockerfile examples isolate
their respective supported layouts. All sample content and credentials are
synthetic. No invoice files, student records, private keys or installed modules
are included.

## Streamlit/local LLM regression

`streamlit-local-llm` reduces the public AI-news-summarizer failure: a Streamlit
entry point imports a CPU-loaded GPT4All model from a Windows path. It preserves
the environment write and CUDA comment that previously produced false positives.
No model, credentials or production data are included or executed by preflight.
